english.title: Attach pipe or apparatus to resource main or pipe vested in the appropriate agency without consent
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the appropriate agency, namely **(..SPECIFY AGENCY..), attached a pipe or apparatus to a resource main or other pipe vested in that agency
